Messages.Author: Malone
Messages.Body:
My question for LSJ: Is a vampire's immunity from being chosen in
Veles' Hunt a "benefit of his or her title", for the purposes of No
Confidence?

No Confidence
Put this card on a titled non-anarch vampire controlled by the target
of the action (or by your predator or prey if the action is
undirected). A vampire with two No Confidence cards loses the benefit
of his or her title. Burn this card if this acting vampire leaves the
ready region.

Veles' Hunt
Blood hunt referendum.
Choose an ally or younger non-titled vampire controlled by your prey.
Successful referendum means that minion is burned. If this referendum
fails or is canceled, no more Veles' Hunts can be played this game.

****

My question for the general populace: How can you remove other
methuselahs' vampires' titles? I came up with the list below. Am I
missing anything, other than forcing a sects change?

Gustav Mallenhaus' special
Sonja Blue's special
Inquisition
Blood Siege
Patsy
Wrath of the Inner Circle
